For a renter’s balcony, I’d start with the **BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W solar panel kit**. It’s a small, portable setup: the **288 Wh battery stays inside**, while you put the panel on the balcony to recharge it—no wiring into the apartment. The listed kit is **$489.99** before the page’s advertised discount. [See the kit and details](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2-100w-solar-kit).

It’s suited to **phones, a laptop, a router, or a fan**; it won’t run a fridge or heater. Check your lease and building rules before placing a panel outside, and secure it so it can’t fall or blow away. [Source and use-case details](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-for-an-apartment-balcony)

If you need to power larger appliances or ride out longer outages, this kit is too small; you’d want a larger power station and panel setup.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W Solar Panel Kit
